title: Coherent quotient presentations and descent of supplied augmented comparisons
statement: For all schemes X and bounded-below complexes K of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], there exist simultaneous termwise hypercohomology presentations P(X,K) [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation] and quotient realizations e [lem-weil-pbc-ce-stationary-page-naturality]. For any scheme map f:Y→X [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], complex map v:f⁻¹K→L, and bicomplex comparison φ:f⁻¹P(X,K).I→P(Y,L).I whose degree-zero components commute with the augmentations, suppose a sheaf-total map u satisfies the nonnegative diagonal summand formula displayed in the Lean statement. If its conjugated sections map b [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison] preserves all complex-degree filtration steps, there exists a spectral-sequence map N induced by b on the actual cycle/boundary representatives. Under the signed first-page identifications, N is Sheaf.H.map(v.f q) after cohomologyMap [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Neither existence of φ nor existence of u is asserted.

proof.text: Take the simultaneous P,e, quotient coherence, and single-component first-page comparison from the coherent presentation theorem. For the supplied u conjugate its sections lift to b; its assumed step restrictions make it a filtered map.

Apply the generic quotient descent theorem to the two sections totals, their filtrations, sequences, realizations and coherence proofs, obtaining N and its all-page representative equation. This equation is definitionally EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives.

For each p,q use the first-page comparison on the component (N.hom 1).f (q,p). Its premise is the preceding representative equation specialized to r=1. Pair the resulting first-page identities with the unchanged all-page representative equation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 015J and 015K; Homology Tag 012K; combining construction/comparison and generic filtered descent

theorem exists_etaleCE_quotient_page_descent :
    ∃ (P : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (e : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleCEQuotientRealization (P X K)),
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
      let D := P X K
      let D' := P Y L
      ∀ (φ : (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.I ⟶ D'.I)
    (hφ : ∀ q : ℤ,
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).map
          ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (K.obj.X q)).inv ≫
            (D.a.f q).f 0) ≫ (φ.f q).f 0 =
        v.f q ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (L.obj.X q)).inv ≫
            (D'.a.f q).f 0)
    (u : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.sheafTotal ⟶ D'.sheafTotal)
    (hu : ∀ (m : ℕ) (q n : ℤ) (h : (m : ℤ) + q = n),
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).map
            ((HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h) ≫ u.f n =
          (φ.f q).f m ≫
            (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D'.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D'.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h),
      let b := D.totalSectionsIso.hom ≫ ceSectionsLift f u ≫ D'.totalSectionsIso.inv
      (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ s : (D.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ) ⟶
          (D'.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ),
        s ≫ (D'.L.step q).arrow = (D.L.step q).arrow ≫ b) →
      ∃ N : D.sequence ⟶ D'.sequence,
        (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        (N.hom 1).f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ (D'.firstPageIso p q).hom =
          (D.firstPageIso p q).hom ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map (v.f q) p).comp
              (cohomologyMap f (K.obj.X q) p))) ∧
        EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives D D' (e X K) (e Y L) b N
